title: 14 There was a marked increase in the number of crimes committed by juveniles. 47,925 juveniles were apprehended in 1959 as against 29774 in 1958, showing an increase by 61.0 per cent. Statistics of juvenile delinquency are being collected since 1958 and it is therefore necessary to watch the trend carefully. Juveniles dealt with
